// Example: simple P95 calculator for latency logs
function p95(arr) {

}

## Why This Is Asked

- Istio per-tenant circuit-breakers and regional routing
- Envoy stats and route inspection per tenant
- Canary rollouts with DestinationRule subsets and VirtualService routing

## Code Example
```javascript
// DestinationRule snippet (per-tenant circuit-breaker)
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1alpha3
kind: DestinationRule
metadata:
  name: tenant-cb
  namespace: kcsa-prod
spec:
  host: "*.svc.cluster.local"
  trafficPolicy:
    connectionPool:
      http:
        http1MaxPendingRequests: 100
        maxConnections: 1000
    outlierDetection:
      consecutiveErrors: 5
      interval: 30s
```
```javascript
// VirtualService canary routing (10% to canary)
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1alpha3
kind: VirtualService
metadata:
  name: gateway-virtual
  namespace: kcsa-prod
spec:
  hosts:
  - gateway.example.com
  http:
  - route:
    - destination:
        host: tenant-api
        subset: v1
      weight: 90
    - destination:
        host: tenant-api
        subset: v1-canary

```
